note: A PluginSource streams AVAILABILITY, never commands. `subscribe` opens a fresh stream and the dev source's SSE endpoint answers every connect with a full snapshot of what is already built, so the same rebuiltAt arrives again on every reconnect and on every re-run of the subscription effect. Routing such a replay to a hot-swap destroys the session-owning plugin's live instance and its document (actor-activation.revoked, then `no channel for instance N`) — ticket 26/09/02, measured in wave B38 §1.7 and diagnosed in wave B40 §1, where switching the UI language was re-running that effect. `loadedRebuiltAt: null` means the artifact was acquired unbusted, i.e. a first load that names no build.

replay.note: The measured shape: a cold boot's snapshot carries ~20 already-built plugins, and the language switch re-subscribed. The first connect installs every one of them; every later connect replaying the SAME snapshot must destroy nothing.
